topic: Is India's coastline really 7,516 km long?

hook.text: Is India's coastline really 7,516 km long?
hook.say: Is India's coastline really seven thousand five hundred and sixteen kilometres long?

lines.say: I'm afraid that's a myth, old chap. Re-measured, India's coastline is eleven thousand and ninety eight kilometres.
lines.cap: I'm afraid that's a MYTH, old chap. Re-measured: 11,098 km of coastline.

lines.say: That's about three thousand five hundred and eighty kilometres more, up nearly forty eight percent. With no new land!
lines.cap: That's about 3,580 km MORE, up nearly 48%. With no new land!

lines.say: The trick? Old maps were zoomed out. The new survey traced every creek. Gujarat almost doubled!
lines.cap: Old maps were zoomed OUT. The new one traced every creek. Gujarat almost DOUBLED!

lines.say: West Bengal's coast grew over four times, to seven hundred and twenty one kilometres, thanks to the Sundarbans' creeks.
lines.cap: West Bengal grew 4.6x, to 721 km, thanks to the Sundarbans' creeks.

lines.say: Which coastal state would you visit first? Tell us below, and share this with a friend!
lines.cap: Which coastal state would you visit first? Tell us below, and share this with a friend!

title: India's coastline is NOT 7,516 km. It's 11,098 km 🌊
description: India's coastline was re-measured: 11,098.81 km, up from the 7,516.6 km figure used since the 1970s, about 48% longer with no new land. Gujarat's coast nearly doubled to 2,340.62 km and West Bengal's grew 4.6x. Which coastal state would you visit first?
